svg.title: StratoSync is live on the App Store for Apple Vision Pro
svg.desc: StratoSync for Apple Vision Pro computes its sky in real time: three GPU-generated environments, Earth lit by the real Sun, live ISS telemetry, and Apple Pencil and Logitech Muse stylus drawing.

g.text: LIVE ON THE APP STORE · APPLE VISION PRO

svg.text: The sky, computed live around you.
